description: Richardson-Dushman with space-charge correction (Schottky-Langmuir), T-dependent work function, lead resistance, and back-emission

unit.name: Cesium-vapor thermionic diode (advanced model)
unit.source: Hatsopoulos & Gyftopoulos (1979) Thermionic Energy Conversion; Houston (1959) J. Appl. Phys.; Angrist (1982) Direct Energy Conversion

phi_emitter_0.note: Emitter work function at T0 (Cs-coated W)

T0_K.note: Reference temperature for work function fit

dphi_dT_emitter.note: Work function T dependence: phi(T) = phi0 + dphi/dT*(T-T0)

space_charge_factor.note: Space-charge current reduction factor (~0.7-0.95 for Cs vapor)
